theme_strategy: Light theme is preferred for Point of Sale (POS) environments to ensure high legibility under bright restaurant/retail lighting. Provide a high-contrast mode if possible.

typography.strategy: Functional Clarity & Speed. Cashiers need to read prices and statuses instantly from an angle.

headings.usage: H1-H4, product names, category labels, big status indicators.

body.usage: Standard UI text, descriptions, small labels.

mono.usage: MANDATORY for all numerical values: prices, SKUs, order numbers, shift totals, and receipts. Ensures numbers align perfectly vertically.

colors.strategy: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Operational POS. Color is function. 90% of UI is structural grayscale; 10% is vibrant status/action colors.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: High Density Grid (Bento) for POS. No wasted space, but large enough for rapid touch interaction.
spacing_and_layout.tap_targets: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, product cards, category filters) MUST be minimum h-14 (56px) or h-16 (64px) for fast touch without looking.
spacing_and_layout.cashier_screen_layout: Landscape-first. Split screen: Left 20% (Vertical Category Filters), Middle 50% (Product Grid, 3-4 cols), Right 30% (Active Cart/Bill, Total, Payment Button fixed at bottom).
spacing_and_layout.table_management_layout: Floor view representation. Grid of square table cards showing Table Number, Capacity, and Status color.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radius: Subtle roundness. `rounded-xl` for cards, `rounded-lg` for buttons. Use 1px borders (`border-border`) extensively to separate items instead of relying heavily on shadows.

surface_strategies.pos_buttons: The 'Tactile' Variant (Neumorphism-lite). Flat background with 1px border. On active/press state: translate-y-[2px] and shadow-inner. Cashiers need visual feedback that a button was pressed.
surface_strategies.cart_panel: Solid surface with a hard left border. Keep it visually anchored.
surface_strategies.receipt_preview: Use a subtle paper texture or a simple white card with dashed top/bottom borders (`border-dashed`) and monospaced font to mimic thermal printing.

icons.style: weight='bold' or weight='fill' for instant recognition from a distance.

components_and_libraries.tables_and_data: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the POS Cashier grid (needs custom layout). Use Shadcn UI for the Admin Dashboard (Tables, Analytics).
components_and_libraries.forms_and_selects: Use Shadcn UI for standard forms (Category/Product CRUD). DO NOT use native HTML `<select>`.
components_and_libraries.toasts: Use `sonner` (top-center positioning for POS so it's in the cashier's line of sight).

motion.strategy: Speed > Elegance. Cashiers hate waiting for animations.
rules: Use `transform scale-95` on active/click for immediate tactile feedback.
Avoid slow fade-ins (`opacity`) for POS grid items.
For Dashboard/Admin, standard staggered entrance animations are acceptable.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA contrast ratios. Do not put white text on yellow/light-orange backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="btn-pay-cash"`, `data-testid="product-card-123"`).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand_primary focus:ring-offset-2`) for keyboard/scanner navigation.

food_items.description: Variety of Indonesian food on table

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, but prefer solid colors for this POS app to prevent visual refraction of data.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`. Left-align for human readability.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, press states. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable, except in the POS grid where high-density but large tap targets are required.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
NEVER use placeholder URLs or text for images. Use the URLs provided in this JSON.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Always use a solid color or heavy blur.
CRITICAL: Implement the landscape-first POS layout exactly: Categories left, Grid center, Cart right. Visual separation of Dine-in/Take-away/Retail must be explicit using the status colors provided.
